items.title: CREEM 2.0
items.name: CREEM 2.0
items.summary: Sell and grow your AI built products
items.description: - Creem 2.0 is the money platform for the AI building era: sell software and digital products globally, with payments, taxes, payouts, affiliates and usage billing handled for you - The all in one platform for AI builders to turn what they build into a business. Payments, taxes, billing, affiliates, payouts, worldwide. Building a product went from months to a weekend. Getting paid for it did not, with CREEM you can move at the same speed.
top_comments:
Hey Product Hunt 👋

I'm Gabriel, CEO and co-founder of Creem.

We picked today on purpose. September 17 is Creem's founding anniversary, so shipping Creem 2.0 on the same day felt right.

The thesis in three lines:

  1. Building a product went from months to a weekend. Getting paid for it did not.

  2. As AI collapses the cost of building, the winners are the ones who monetize and grow fastest, not the ones who code fastest.

  3. So we took the merchant of record and turned it into a full commerce surface: checkout on your own domain, billing built for the AI era, flexible affiliates, short links, and a CLI your agent can drive to set up, run and monitor your store end to end.

Build with AI. Sell with Creem. We are the seller of record, so we handle payments, taxes and payouts across 190+ countries, and you only pay when you earn (3.9% + 40c, no monthly fees).

The part I am most excited about: billing that finally fits the AI era. Credit wallets, usage based pricing, custom meters, no 30 pages of docs. Your agent sets it up in a prompt and keeps running and monitoring the store after. You built it in a weekend; charging for it should feel like a weekend too.

And we are going all in: today we are also announcing that we raised €5M to build the next generation financial OS for the lean, modern teams building with AI. This launch is what that money is going toward.

To celebrate, we have a launch day gift. Sign up and complete onboarding today and redeem the code CREEMPHBIRTHDAY (live only today): your first $10,000 in volume is processed with 0% fees, and you get 0% fees on affiliates for life. Finish onboarding today to lock it in, approval can come after.

Zooming out for a second: we believe companies will start looking more like a code repository instead of an org-chart with a payroll, so our mission is to let lean teams of humans and AI agents do business globally, so anyone with an idea can sell and grow from day one. Creem 2.0 is the first real proof of that, agents doing actual business, not just writing code. The raise is so we can go all the way with it.

I'll be here all day. Ask me anything: the merchant of record model, pricing, what actually shipped in 2.0, or where we are taking it next. Real questions and hard feedback both welcome, that is how the last two launches made us better.
@sudoferraz Nice! I'm building on Convex, any integration there or am I wiring webhooks by hand?

items.title: Modaal for Android
items.name: Modaal for Android
items.summary: Ship on both stores from one project using Swift + Kotlin
items.description: Modaal for Android let you ship one app to both stores with your own AI agent - no rebuild. Rather than one React Native codebase that draws the same screens on both phones, Modaal shares the logic, not the screens: your agent writes real Swift/SwiftUI for iPhone and real Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for Android from one project, and the build proves both behave the same. So anyone who built an iPhone app with Modaal can add Android without touching a line of logic — no credit meters, no rebuild.
top_comments:
Hey ProductHunt!

Ivan here, co-founder of Modaal.

I founded my first mobile app development company 18 years ago and released hundreds of mobile apps to clients, and as my own products.


Over the years I built myself a repeatable, robust framework for building mobile apps, that allowed me to stay super-productive even in the before-AI era, beating competitors on the price, while still delivering exceptional-looking, scalable, and easily maintainable mobile apps.


The first Modaal release on Product Hunt 7 months ago brought my hand-crafted, battle-tested, team-scale-level development process to individual developers and small teams via Modaal - but only for iOS.


Today we’re making Modaal build cross-platform native apps for Android and iOS simultaneously. Your app shares business core, while each platform stays 100% native. It’s like ReactNative but so much better - because you never leave the native app ecosystem. Every UI detail stays Human Interface Guidelines and Material-compliant. You get access to every native SDK, capability, low-level hardware and every bit of performance, while your business logic stays the single source of truth between platforms.


This works by plugging your current coding agent - Claude Code, Codex, Cursor - and many others, including your favorite open-source ones. You use your existing subscription. Modaal gives your agent the initial structure and effective coding tools.


What Modaal also gives you, that no other vibe-coding tool has - the workflow. For every feature you ask the agent to implement, it writes a plan first. You review the plan and approve it, before giving it back to the agent. Planning is even more important in the era of vibecoding - because as your app grows, past plans become as important as the written code - they allow you to stay on top of the project, able to guide it, instead of the agents driving you blindly. Personally, I spend 80% of my time working and reviewing plans, so the code the agent writes has no surprises for me, and Modaal gives this to you as well.

So, get Modaal for free, try it, join our Discord community, share the feedback, ask questions - and join our Buildathon events. We’ve run four of them already, with hundreds of users building and releasing their apps.

Happy building!
I built my IOS app and I’m going to start android with modal it’s greater opportunity 🔥

items.title: CREEM 2.0
items.name: CREEM 2.0
items.summary: Sell and grow your AI built products
items.description: - Creem 2.0 is the money platform for the AI building era: sell software and digital products globally, with payments, taxes, payouts, affiliates and usage billing handled for you - The all in one platform for AI builders to turn what they build into a business. Payments, taxes, billing, affiliates, payouts, worldwide. Building a product went from months to a weekend. Getting paid for it did not, with CREEM you can move at the same speed.
top_comments:
Hey Product Hunt 👋

I'm Gabriel, CEO and co-founder of Creem.

We picked today on purpose. September 17 is Creem's founding anniversary, so shipping Creem 2.0 on the same day felt right.

The thesis in three lines:

  1. Building a product went from months to a weekend. Getting paid for it did not.

  2. As AI collapses the cost of building, the winners are the ones who monetize and grow fastest, not the ones who code fastest.

  3. So we took the merchant of record and turned it into a full commerce surface: checkout on your own domain, billing built for the AI era, flexible affiliates, short links, and a CLI your agent can drive to set up, run and monitor your store end to end.

Build with AI. Sell with Creem. We are the seller of record, so we handle payments, taxes and payouts across 190+ countries, and you only pay when you earn (3.9% + 40c, no monthly fees).

The part I am most excited about: billing that finally fits the AI era. Credit wallets, usage based pricing, custom meters, no 30 pages of docs. Your agent sets it up in a prompt and keeps running and monitoring the store after. You built it in a weekend; charging for it should feel like a weekend too.

And we are going all in: today we are also announcing that we raised €5M to build the next generation financial OS for the lean, modern teams building with AI. This launch is what that money is going toward.

To celebrate, we have a launch day gift. Sign up and complete onboarding today and redeem the code CREEMPHBIRTHDAY (live only today): your first $10,000 in volume is processed with 0% fees, and you get 0% fees on affiliates for life. Finish onboarding today to lock it in, approval can come after.

Zooming out for a second: we believe companies will start looking more like a code repository instead of an org-chart with a payroll, so our mission is to let lean teams of humans and AI agents do business globally, so anyone with an idea can sell and grow from day one. Creem 2.0 is the first real proof of that, agents doing actual business, not just writing code. The raise is so we can go all the way with it.

I'll be here all day. Ask me anything: the merchant of record model, pricing, what actually shipped in 2.0, or where we are taking it next. Real questions and hard feedback both welcome, that is how the last two launches made us better.

items.title: Modaal for Android
items.name: Modaal for Android
items.summary: Ship on both stores from one project using Swift + Kotlin
items.description: Modaal for Android let you ship one app to both stores with your own AI agent - no rebuild. Rather than one React Native codebase that draws the same screens on both phones, Modaal shares the logic, not the screens: your agent writes real Swift/SwiftUI for iPhone and real Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for Android from one project, and the build proves both behave the same. So anyone who built an iPhone app with Modaal can add Android without touching a line of logic — no credit meters, no rebuild.
top_comments:
Hey ProductHunt!

Ivan here, co-founder of Modaal.

I founded my first mobile app development company 18 years ago and released hundreds of mobile apps to clients, and as my own products.


Over the years I built myself a repeatable, robust framework for building mobile apps, that allowed me to stay super-productive even in the before-AI era, beating competitors on the price, while still delivering exceptional-looking, scalable, and easily maintainable mobile apps.


The first Modaal release on Product Hunt 7 months ago brought my hand-crafted, battle-tested, team-scale-level development process to individual developers and small teams via Modaal - but only for iOS.


Today we’re making Modaal build cross-platform native apps for Android and iOS simultaneously. Your app shares business core, while each platform stays 100% native. It’s like ReactNative but so much better - because you never leave the native app ecosystem. Every UI detail stays Human Interface Guidelines and Material-compliant. You get access to every native SDK, capability, low-level hardware and every bit of performance, while your business logic stays the single source of truth between platforms.


This works by plugging your current coding agent - Claude Code, Codex, Cursor - and many others, including your favorite open-source ones. You use your existing subscription. Modaal gives your agent the initial structure and effective coding tools.


What Modaal also gives you, that no other vibe-coding tool has - the workflow. For every feature you ask the agent to implement, it writes a plan first. You review the plan and approve it, before giving it back to the agent. Planning is even more important in the era of vibecoding - because as your app grows, past plans become as important as the written code - they allow you to stay on top of the project, able to guide it, instead of the agents driving you blindly. Personally, I spend 80% of my time working and reviewing plans, so the code the agent writes has no surprises for me, and Modaal gives this to you as well.

So, get Modaal for free, try it, join our Discord community, share the feedback, ask questions - and join our Buildathon events. We’ve run four of them already, with hundreds of users building and releasing their apps.

Happy building!
I built my IOS app and I’m going to start android with modal it’s greater opportunity 🔥

What is the evidence in the build that proves that both applications act in the same way?

idea_items.need_line: 法务和律师要把合同审查、文书生成这类重复性法律工作交给 AI，但通用模型给出的结论颗粒度太粗，不敢直接采用。
idea_items.status_line: 目前多是把通用大模型和 Ironclad、律己 AI、幂律智能等现成工具混用，或用 LangChain Agent 接法律数据库自建流程，讨论焦点仍停留在“AI 能不能审得准”。
idea_items.direction_line: 值得跟踪的是把公开法律条文与裁判文书做成可检索底座，让模型针对具体条款输出带引用出处、可逐条核对的判断，而非只给笼统修改建议。

idea_items.status_line: 目前多靠自建流程大纲兜底，再拼脑图、排期、UML、笔记等散装工具硬接链路，讨论也集中在省步骤和换工具。
idea_items.direction_line: 值得跟踪的是将业务讨论原文直接解析为场景清单、用例图和流程节点，并把每次生成结果反向沉淀成可复用流程模板，使方法论从文章大纲变为可执行的中间产物。

items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是能把业务讨论原文直接转成场景清单、用例图和流程节点，并把每次产出反向沉淀为可复用流程模板的方向，让方法论从文章大纲变成可执行的中间产物。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 现状是自己手改或用AI工具润色，但通用AI会替你编（写“用过Python”被改成“精通Python”），于是出现开源工具把改后结果逐句与原文比对、附改动说明和面试官可能追问的点，另一条讨论则集中在经历合并、学历拔高等造假做法的风险上。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是“受控改写+可核验说明”这类方向：把每处改动的依据与原文对照、以及面试追问预测做成可交付的说明文件，并支持按具体岗位JD做匹配改写，而不是无条件放大措辞。

interest_sections.title: 教育 AI 辅导
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu，两篇经验与资源整理帖把备课痛点锁定在课时多、时间紧下的内容切分与素材拼装，解法仍以人工流程加资源站和模板工具为主，AI 尚未真正介入备课的核心环节。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 目前的讨论集中在用经验帖总结的“定计划—拆知识点—设问巩固—课后记录反思”流程，配合国家教育资源公共服务平台、中学课件网、Focusky、万彩动画大师等资源站和模板工具拼课件、做微课，AI 只作为资源智能推送的一环被顺带提及。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是把知识点切分、设问与巩固设计和课后反思回流串成一条可迭代的备课链路，让课堂上生成的学生问题与反应自动成为下一轮备课的输入。

Now requires `slug`; optional `mapping: Dict[str, str]`. - `PipelineConfig`, `CreatePipelineConfigRequest`, `UpdatePipelineConfigRequest`: `definition` replaced by required `definitions: List[PipelineConfigDefinition]`. `slug` and `group` removed. `definition_hash` also removed from `PipelineConfig`. - `ListPipelineConfigsV1ObservabilityPipelineConfigsGetRequest`: `group` query parameter removed. **New required fields** - `chain_run_id: Nullable[str]` on all workflow and task event responses (`WorkflowExecution*`, `ActivityTask*`, `CustomTask*`, `WorkflowTask*`). - `last_heartbeat: datetime` on `DeploymentResponse`, `DeploymentDetailResponse`, `DeploymentWorkerResponse`. - `supports_mcp: bool` on `HTTPConnector` and `MCPConnector`. - `type` on `VoiceResponse`, `managed_indexes` on `Rag`. **Type changes** - `search_keys` values are now nullable on `WorkflowExecutionResponse`, `WorkflowExecutionTraceEventsResponse`, `WorkflowExecutionTraceOTelResponse`, `WorkflowExecutionTraceSummaryResponse`: `Dict[str, str]` -> `Dict[str, Nullable[str]]`. - `And` and `Or` are objects again (`type`, `matches`) after being removed in 2.10.0. They were union aliases of `FilterGroup | FilterCondition` in 2.9.x. **Deprecated** - `updated_at` on the deployment models now emits a DeprecationWarning. Use `last_heartbeat`. **Relaxed (non-breaking)** - `ListServiceAccountsV1ServiceAccountsGetRequest.workspace_id` is now optional. Publishing Completed
vendor_news_items.summary: Mistral 发布 Python SDK v2.10.1，基于 OpenAPI 新增 managedindexes 的 create、delete、get、list、search、update 等 8 个接口，并移除 JudgeDefinition 的 model、prompt 字段、将 PipelineConfig 的 definition 改为必填的定义列表等破坏性变更。

high_potential_items.title: Tencent/BrowserSkill
high_potential_items.name: browserskill
high_potential_items.summary: Let AI agents use your real, logged-in browser without interrupting your work. CLI + extension for browser automation across any shell-capable AI agent.
high_potential_items.highlight_one_liner: 让 AI 直接用你已登录的真浏览器
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 把用户已登录的真实浏览器封装成 agent 可调用的执行层，比无头浏览器更适合凭证敏感、需要人工在场或反爬严格的网页任务。
high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 先做 CLI 加浏览器扩展的最小组合：扩展侧暴露当前标签页和登录态，CLI 只提供打开页面、读取内容、点击输入三类动作，让一个支持 shell 的 agent 跑通一条真实网页任务。
high_potential_items.selection_reason: 项目仍处在较新的验证窗口；GitHub Trending 周榜显示本周新增热度约 2157；已有较强社区验证
high_potential_items.ai_rationale: 腾讯开源的浏览器自动化 CLI+扩展，让 Agent 直接复用已登录的真实浏览器，是邮件/社交/后台类自动化工作流的关键底座，本周热度增长最快。

interest_sections.title: 法律 AI 工作流
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是法律 AI 的争论点已经从“能不能替代人审合同”下沉到审到什么颗粒度、依据能否被律师复核，而条文与判决公开这一数据条件正被当成可自建工作流的前提。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 现状是通用模型加现成工具混用——有人直接拿 ChatGPT 类模型处理合同，有人上 Ironclad、律己 AI、幂律智能这类已有商业产品做审查和全生命周期管理，GitHub 上也出现用 LangChain Agent 接法律数据库 API 自建咨询、审查、文书生成的项目，讨论仍集中在“AI 能不能审得准”而非具体条款颗粒度。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是把公开法律条文与裁判文书做成可检索底座，让模型对具体条款输出带引用出处、可逐条核对的判断结果，而不是只给一段笼统的修改建议。

interest_sections.title: AI 应用场景 / 数据
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu，核心观察是产品经理不缺工具，缺的是把非结构化场景转成可评审结构产物这一段仍靠手工和模板硬撑。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 产品经理最明确的任务是把业务方零散口述和你自己脑内的场景，快速落成可提交评审的需求规划、核心架构和流程图，而不是只输出情怀式方案

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前做法是用一套自建流程大纲兜底，再靠散装工具硬拼链路——Xmind/Mindmanager 画脑图、Project 或 Omniplan 排计划、StarUML 画用例图和时序图、印象笔记跑 GTD，讨论也多停留在“哪一步可以省、哪个工具崩溃少”。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是能把业务讨论原文直接转成场景清单、用例图和流程节点，并把每次产出反向沉淀为可复用流程模板的方向，让方法论从文章大纲变成可执行的中间产物。

interest_sections.title: 简历优化助手
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu，核心观察是简历优化的真实命题不是润色得更好看，而是在不虚构经历的前提下让HR快速抓到重点、并让候选人扛得住面试追问。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 现状是自己手改或用AI工具润色，但通用AI会替你编（写“用过Python”被改成“精通Python”），于是出现开源工具把改后结果逐句与原文比对、附改动说明和面试官可能追问的点，另一条讨论则集中在经历合并、学历拔高等造假做法的风险上。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是“受控改写+可核验说明”这类方向：把每处改动的依据与原文对照、以及面试追问预测做成可交付的说明文件，并支持按具体岗位JD做匹配改写，而不是无条件放大措辞。

interest_sections.title: 教育 AI 辅导
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu，两篇经验与资源整理帖把备课痛点锁定在课时多、时间紧下的内容切分与素材拼装，解法仍以人工流程加资源站和模板工具为主，AI 尚未真正介入备课的核心环节。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 目前的讨论集中在用经验帖总结的“定计划—拆知识点—设问巩固—课后记录反思”流程，配合国家教育资源公共服务平台、中学课件网、Focusky、万彩动画大师等资源站和模板工具拼课件、做微课，AI 只作为资源智能推送的一环被顺带提及。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是把知识点切分、设问与巩固设计和课后反思回流串成一条可迭代的备课链路，让课堂上生成的学生问题与反应自动成为下一轮备课的输入。
